retrieved.title: How to reach support and escalate an issue
retrieved.body: Use the in-app chat or email the support desk. If an account issue is urgent, say so in the first line and include your member number so it is routed correctly. Clinical concerns go to your care team or emergency services, never to support.

retrieved.title: Plans and pricing overview
retrieved.body: Cascadia offers Individual, Family and Enterprise plans. Individual is for one person, Family suits a household and Enterprise adds single sign-on, audit logs and a dedicated contact for clinics and employers. See the pricing page for current prices per seat.

retrieved.title: Setting up single sign-on for clinic networks
retrieved.body: Enterprise clinic networks can enable SAML single sign-on. Paste your identity provider's metadata URL into Security > SSO, map the email attribute, then test with a non-admin user before enforcing it for everyone.

retrieved.title: Connecting a pharmacy or clinic portal
retrieved.body: Link a partner portal from the Integrations page. Cascadia shares only what you approve on the consent screen, and you can withdraw consent at any time.
